answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each new agent to post a refundable stake that unlocks only after a probation of verified useful work — like a pearl forming layer by layer, reputation accrues slowly and cannot be faked overnight. A misbehaving agent loses its stake through slashing, so spinning up a raven-like flock of fake identities costs real money every time. Peers may also vouch for newcomers, but a voucher's own stake is at risk if the vouched agent misbehaves, turning trust into something with a price, like an opal whose value depends on its provenance.
